senses.gloss:
तुतात तुतात, अस्, m., N. of the founder of
a philosophical system; [cf. तौतातिक.]

तुतुर्वणि तुतुर्वणि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 1. तुर्),
Ved. striving to bring near or obtain; (Sāy.) acting
with alacrity, acting speedily; [cf. जुगुर्वणि and
शुशुक्वनि.]

तुत्थ तुत्थ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. तुद्),
fire; (आ), f. the Indigo plant; small cardamoms;
(अम्), n. blue vitriol, sulphate of copper, especially
considered as an ointment or medical application to
the eyes; a collyrium extracted from the Amomum
Zanthorrhiza; a stone, a rock.
—तुत्थाञ्जन
(˚थ-अञ्˚), अम्, n. blue vitriol as an ointment or
medicinal application to the eyes.
तूतक तूतक, अम्, n. = तुत्थ, blue vitriol.

तूतुजान तूतुजान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. तुज्),
Ved. hastening, quick, eager, ardent.

तूतुजि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. quick, swift; (a various
reading has तूतुजित्.)

तूतुम तूतुम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. granting
much (?); (Sāy.) quick, active; [cf. तुम्र.]
